name: Macronutrients including energy
definition: Top-level INFOODS family. Carries no parameters itself - a parameter attaches to the deepest group, as a stream attaches to its deepest classification term

name: Water
definition: Water and its complement. Dry matter is registered here rather than under ash because INFOODS treats the water axis as one family

name: Protein
definition: INFOODS family. Carries no parameters itself: the nitrogen-derived figures and the individual amino acids are its two leaves, which is how INFOODS separates them

name: Fat components
definition: INFOODS family. Carries no parameters itself: total fat and the individual fatty acids are its two leaves

name: Carbohydrates
definition: INFOODS family. Carries no parameters itself: the summed determinations and the individual wall monomers are its two leaves

name: Dietary fibre and dietary fibre fractions
definition: Every fibre fraction, whichever tradition defined it - AOAC dietary fibre, Weende crude fibre and the Van Soest detergent fractions all live here. They are DIFFERENT FRACTIONS, not one fraction measured differently

name: Ash and other solids
definition: Mineral residue and the organic complement

name: Energy
definition: Calorific value. Feed sources call it gross energy, fuel sources call it HHV - one quantity, one group

name: Minerals and trace elements
definition: Mineral elements as nutrients, including the agronomic oxide forms P2O5 and K2O

name: Heavy metals and contaminants
definition: Elements that decide which applications a stream is admissible for

name: Bioactive constituents
definition: INFOODS nests flavonoids, tannins, phenolic acids and other bioactives here. Only a total-polyphenol figure is registered so far - the subfamilies enter when a source reports them

name: Solid-biofuel characterisation
definition: THE SEAM. INFOODS has no place for combustion characterisation, so this branch is adopted from the solid-biofuel standards instead - the same CEN/TS methods Phyllis2 records cite. Carries no parameters itself

name: Proximate analysis
definition: Volatile matter and fixed carbon. Not the Weende proximate partition and not to be confused with it

name: Ultimate (elemental) analysis
definition: The CHNOS plus chlorine set, and the C/N ratio derived from it. Sulphur and chlorine sit here rather than with the minerals because the ultimate analysis is a defined standard set that includes them - not because our sources happen to report them that way

name: Physical properties
definition: Bulk, particle and water-relation properties. Neither INFOODS nor ISO 17225 carries these as a family, so this branch is ours and is labelled as such. Feeds the transport and handling side of the model

name: Miscellaneous
definition: INFOODS closes its list with this family and so do we. pH and the effluent-load parameters are not food components in any tradition

name: Ash melting behaviour
definition: Characteristic temperatures at which the ash softens and flows. Not a composition figure but a thermal property of the ash, and the one that decides whether a stream can be burnt without slagging

name: Total protein and nitrogen
definition: Nitrogen, and the protein figures derived from it

name: Individual amino acids
definition: INFOODS heads this "Individual amino acids and aggregations". Recorded as ABSOLUTE content (g/kg on the sheet basis), never as the g/16g N the feed tables lead with - that is an EXPRESSION relative to protein, not a unit, and BioMobi has no expression axis

name: Total fat
definition: Total lipid. The extraction used is a METHOD on the measurement

name: Individual fatty acids
definition: INFOODS nests individual fatty acids under Fat components. Recorded as ABSOLUTE content (g/kg on the sheet basis), never as the "% of total fatty acids" the feed tables lead with - that is a share of a sum, not a content, and it cannot be compared across materials

name: Structural carbohydrates
definition: The cell-wall polysaccharides reported as their monomer anhydro-sugars - arabinan, xylan, glucan and the rest. INFOODS nests individual carbohydrates under Carbohydrates; a sugar-analysis laboratory reports the wall this way rather than as cellulose and hemicellulose, and the two are not interconvertible by arithmetic

name: Total carbohydrates and sugars
definition: Carbohydrate reported as a summed or by-difference fraction - starch, total sugars, the named mono- and disaccharides, the Weende nitrogen-free extract
